meta.title: Book a lab test or session
meta.description: Pick a test or training session and a time that suits you. Book in a minute, pay on site.

service.heading: What would you like to book?
service.required: Choose what you'd like to book.

time.heading: Pick a date and time
time.empty: There are no free times in the next two months. Call or write and we'll find one.
time.slotTaken: Someone has just booked that time. Please pick another one; your details are kept.

details.heading: Your details
details.name: Full name
details.phoneHint: In case we need to reach you on the day.
details.healthConsent: I agree that my answers to the health questions are processed to run the test safely, as described in the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

errors.name: Enter your name.
errors.healthConsent: Please agree to the processing of your health answers.

health.heading: Health questions
health.intro: A lab test means hard effort. These questions are from the standard PAR-Q+ form and help keep the test safe.

questions.heart_condition: Has your doctor ever said that you have a heart condition or high blood pressure?
questions.chest_pain: Do you feel pain in your chest at rest, during daily activities, or when you are physically active?
questions.dizziness: Do you lose balance because of dizziness, or have you lost consciousness in the last 12 months? (Answer no if the dizziness came from over-breathing, including during hard exercise.)
questions.chronic_condition: Have you ever been diagnosed with another chronic medical condition (other than heart disease or high blood pressure)?
questions.medication: Are you currently taking prescribed medication for a chronic medical condition?
questions.bone_joint: Do you have, or have you had in the last 12 months, a bone, joint or soft tissue (muscle, ligament or tendon) problem that could get worse with more physical activity? (Answer no if it doesn't limit you now.)
questions.supervised_only: Has your doctor ever said that you should only do medically supervised physical activity?

health.other: Anything else about your health we should know? (optional)
health.doctorNote: You answered yes to at least one question. Please talk to your doctor before the test and make sure hard exercise is safe for you. You can still book now.

review.heading: Check and confirm
review.name: Name
review.payOnSite: You pay on site, on the day.

unavailable.title: Booking isn't working right now
unavailable.text: Sorry, something went wrong on our side. Call or email and we'll book you in by hand.

confirmed.heading: You're booked
confirmed.text: The confirmation is on its way to {email}.
confirmed.payOnSite: You pay on site, on the day.

account.title: Keep your bookings in one place
account.text: With an account you see your bookings and, after the test, your results. Sign in with this email; no password needed.

manage.heading: Your booking
manage.cancelConfirm: Cancel this booking? The time goes back to the calendar.
manage.cancelled: This booking is cancelled. We've sent you an email.
manage.tooLate: Free cancellation ends 24 hours before the start, so it can't be cancelled here any more. Please call or email.
manage.notFound: We can't find this booking. Check that you opened the full link from your email.
